title: Gromov’s integral scalar-curvature bound for simplicial volume

result.label: Gromov’s integral scalar-curvature bound for simplicial volume
result.statement: Proves ( Scal g^-)^ n/2 ,dVg an M for every closed connected oriented smooth n -manifold, n ≥ 3, and every smooth metric, with an 0 depending only on dimension. Here Scal g^-= 0,- Scal g and M is real simplicial volume. Also proves rational inessentiality under positive scalar curvature, resolving the Gromov–Lawson conjecture; every nonnegative-scalar-curvature metric on a closed aspherical manifold is flat.
